meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: Claude 会按你的 git 需求进入四种模式之一:提交、改写历史(rebase/squash)、查历史(blame、bisect、reflog)、只看状态。它先读仓库现状再下判断,按仓库既有风格写提交信息,并给出提交哈希和所用命令作为证据。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码或调查 git 历史时触发;只是普通改代码时不介入。改写历史等有共享影响的操作,只有你明确要求才会做。

say.text: 把这几个改动拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 按行为、模块分组,各自单独提交

say.text: 这个 bug 是哪个 commit 引入的?用 bisect 找
say.note: 定位第一个出问题的提交并给哈希

say.text: 这个文件第 20-40 行是谁最后改的?
say.note: 用 git blame 给出行级作者与提交

howto.what_en: Claude handles git in four modes: commit, rewrite history (rebase/squash), investigate history (blame, bisect, reflog), or inspect status. It reads repo state first, matches the repo's commit style, and reports hashes and command evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skipped for ordinary code edits. History rewriting only happens if you explicitly ask.

say_en.text: Split these changes into separate atomic commits
say_en.note: Groups by behavior and module, one commit each

say_en.text: Which commit introduced this bug? Use bisect
say_en.note: Finds the first bad commit and its hash

say_en.text: Who last changed lines 20-40 of this file?
say_en.note: Uses git blame for line-level author and commit
